description: This source file defines the 'RandomDataImpl' class, which implements the 'RandomData' interface and provides a variety of methods for generating random data, distributions, and related operations. It delegates actual implementations to a 'RandomDataGenerator' instance and includes methods for generating random strings, numbers, and samples from various distributions.

classes.name: RandomDataImpl
classes.description: Implementation of the RandomData interface that delegates to a RandomDataGenerator for producing a variety of random data and distribution samples, with support for reseeding and security configurations.

methods.name: nextHexString
methods.description: Generates a random hexadecimal string of specified length.

methods.name: nextInt
methods.description: Returns a random integer within the specified bounds.

methods.name: nextLong
methods.description: Returns a random long within the specified bounds.

methods.name: nextSecureHexString
methods.description: Generates a cryptographically secure hexadecimal string of specified length.

methods.name: nextSecureInt
methods.description: Returns a cryptographically secure random integer within bounds.

methods.name: nextSecureLong
methods.description: Returns a cryptographically secure random long within bounds.

methods.name: nextPoisson
methods.description: Generates a Poisson-distributed random number with the specified mean.

methods.name: nextGaussian
methods.description: Generates a Gaussian (normal) distributed random number with given mean and standard deviation.

methods.name: nextExponential
methods.description: Generates an exponentially distributed random number.

methods.name: nextUniform
methods.description: Generates a uniformly distributed random number between lower and upper bounds.

methods.name: nextBeta
methods.description: Generates a random number from a Beta distribution.

methods.name: nextBinomial
methods.description: Samples from a Binomial distribution with specified number of trials and success probability.

methods.name: nextCauchy
methods.description: Samples from a Cauchy distribution with given median and scale.

methods.name: nextChiSquare
methods.description: Samples from a Chi-Squared distribution with specified degrees of freedom.

methods.name: nextF
methods.description: Samples from an F distribution with specified numerator and denominator degrees of freedom.

methods.name: nextGamma
methods.description: Samples from a Gamma distribution with given shape and scale.

methods.name: nextHypergeometric
methods.description: Samples from a Hypergeometric distribution.

methods.name: nextPascal
methods.description: Samples from a Pascal (Negative Binomial) distribution.

methods.name: nextT
methods.description: Samples from a T distribution with specified degrees of freedom.

methods.name: nextWeibull
methods.description: Samples from a Weibull distribution.

methods.name: nextZipf
methods.description: Samples from a Zipf distribution.

methods.name: reSeed
methods.description: Reseeds the internal pseudo-random generator with a specific seed.

methods.name: reSeedSecure
methods.description: Reseeds the secure random generator with current time.

methods.name: reSeedSecure
methods.description: Reseeds the secure random generator with a specific seed.

methods.name: reSeed
methods.description: Reseeds the pseudo-random generator with time-based seed.

methods.name: setSecureAlgorithm
methods.description: Sets the algorithm and provider for the secure random generator.

methods.name: nextPermutation
methods.description: Generates a random permutation of size n, choosing k elements.

methods.name: nextSample
methods.description: Randomly samples k elements from a collection.

methods.name: nextInversionDeviate
methods.description: Generates a random deviate from a distribution via inverse transform sampling.
